subject: new head n49 after upper_lid_line_even x2, eye close-ups vs the MHS3 frame, docs/qa/newhead/eyes_n49c.png
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, male protagonist

outline_shape.reference: wide rounded almond; both corners rounded; the lower lid is a deep smooth curve; the upper lid is a gentle arch peaking slightly toward the inner side
outline_shape.ours: almond; the inner corner is slightly rounded; the outer corner is a point; the upper lid rises steeply from the inner corner; the lower lid is a shallow slope

height_to_width.reference: the opening is a little more than half as tall as it is wide
height_to_width.ours: the opening is about half as tall as it is wide

eye_spacing.reference: the gap between the two eyes is a little more than one eye width
eye_spacing.ours: the gap between the two eyes is about one eye width

iris_size.reference: a tall oval iris filling almost the whole eye height, about 45 percent of the eye width, top cut by the upper lid
iris_size.ours: a tall oval iris filling the whole eye height, about 40 percent of the eye width, top cut by the upper lid

iris_colour.reference: medium saturated green with a lighter mint area covering the lower half of the iris
iris_colour.ours: medium saturated green, slightly darker, with a lighter mint area in the lower third of the iris

iris_pattern.reference: two or three thin dark concentric arcs on the inner side of the iris, clearly visible, plus a dark outline around the iris
iris_pattern.ours: two thin dark concentric arcs on the inner side of the iris, visible, plus a dark outline around the iris

pupil.reference: a dark vertical oval about a quarter of the iris width
pupil.ours: a dark vertical oval about a quarter of the iris width

highlight.reference: one white horizontal oval at the inner edge of the iris, overlapping the white of the eye, at mid height
highlight.ours: one white horizontal oval at the inner edge of the iris at mid height, plus a tiny second white dot low on the outer side

sclera.reference: light neutral grey, with a darker grey band under the upper lid
sclera.ours: light grey with a slight lavender tint, with a darker grey-lavender band under the upper lid

upper_lid_line.reference: a medium dark-brown line of fairly even thickness, slightly thicker at the outer end, wrapping around the outer corner
upper_lid_line.ours: a dark-brown line of fairly even medium thickness, slightly thicker at the outer end, wrapping a short way around the outer corner

lower_lid_line.reference: a thin brown line along the whole lower lid, joining the upper line at the outer corner
lower_lid_line.ours: a thin, faint light-brown line along the middle part of the lower lid only

brow_shape.reference: a thick brush stroke with a blunt inner end, thickest in the first third, tapering to a point, with a gentle arch
brow_shape.ours: a thick wedge with a blunt diagonal inner end, tapering to a long thin point, almost straight

brow_position.reference: close above the eye: at the inner end the gap is about a quarter of the eye height, rising toward the outer end
brow_position.ours: above the eye: at the inner end the gap is about a third of the eye height, rising toward the outer end

brow_colour.reference: dark brown with darker brush hatching
brow_colour.ours: medium-dark brown with fine darker diagonal hatching

flatness.reference: the eye reads as flat paint on the skin with no depth or socket
flatness.ours: the eye reads as flat paint on the skin with no depth or socket
